title: Introduction to AWS SBG Club
shortDesc: Discover the AWS Student Builder Group, its activities, learning opportunities, projects, and how students can start their AWS journey.
fullDesc: An introductory seminar to the AWS Student Builder Group at GSMCOE, designed to give students a complete overview of the community, its purpose, activities, and opportunities. The session will explain what AWS Student Builder Groups are, how students can participate, how to create and verify an AWS Builder Center account, and how to make the most of the AWS learning ecosystem. Students will be introduced to AWS and cloud learning pathways, hands-on workshops, technical sessions, practical labs, project-building activities, challenges, hackathons, certification guidance, curated learning resources, peer collaboration, and relevant internship and career opportunities shared through the community.

title: AWS SBG GSMCOE: Learn, Build & Grow
shortDesc: Explore the complete AWS SBG GSMCOE roadmap, upcoming communities, learning paths, projects, competitions, certifications, hackathons, and student opportunities.
fullDesc: An online community orientation session covering the complete AWS Student Builder Group roadmap at GSMCOE. Students will get a detailed overview of the activities planned for the academic year, including the formation of multiple technology-focused communities, structured AWS and cloud learning paths, emerging technology sessions, hands-on labs, industry-ready project building, project team roles and responsibilities, technical competitions, quizzes, hackathons, build challenges, certification guidance, AWS Builder Center resources, peer collaboration, project showcases, certificates and recognition, and relevant internship and career opportunities. The session will also explain how students can participate in community activities, contribute to projects, build their portfolios, collaborate with other builders, and stay updated through the official AWS SBG GSMCOE portal and community channels. The objective is to help every student understand how they can start from their current skill level and progressively learn, build, compete, and grow with the AWS SBG GSMCOE community.
location: Online - Meeting link will be shared through the official AWS SBG GSMCOE community and portal
